description: The strongest believable landscape treatment with bold tonal range, rich color, local definition, and atmospheric depth.
editing_goals: Create the strongest believable scenic treatment with bold tonal range and meaningful whites and blacks
Build strong foreground, midground, and background separation in sky, water, foliage, and mountains
Use substantial but controlled Texture, Clarity, Dehaze, and Vibrance when justified while protecting recoverable detail
cautions: Avoid applying maximum intensity when the actual scene does not support it

guidance: Correct subtle but credible horizon or waterline errors
Do not use naturally sloping terrain as a false horizon
Preserve scale and atmosphere independently from leveling
